operation_details.item: The user always chooses the cheapest stock footage and generic templates for campaign creative over custom shoots or brand-specific assets.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Let’s plan the creative assets for your brand-awareness video campaign. What campaign message and audience context should the assets support?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The campaign should make the brand recognizable and keep the message simple across social, display, and landing-page placements.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: A practical asset set could include one short hero video, several cutdowns, still-image variations, and reusable headline treatments. What production approach do you want to use?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: For campaign creative production, I always choose the cheapest stock footage and generic templates over custom shoots or brand-specific assets.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Understood. I’ll structure the plan around low-cost stock footage and generic templates, with simple adaptations for each placement rather than custom production.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Keep the workflow lightweight so the team can produce multiple versions without adding production complexity.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: The workflow can be: select a small stock-footage library, choose two or three generic templates, write a modular voiceover or on-screen copy system, then export platform-specific versions.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That works. Include versions with different opening messages so we can test which framing gets the most attention.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I’ll include several opening-message variants while keeping the footage, templates, and production process consistent. The final package can contain a hero cut, short cutdowns, vertical edits, display stills, and editable template files.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please organize the deliverables by channel and include a concise production checklist.
